# Experience First: product principle for Muse agents

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): @cursor's Experience First principle for when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up — choose user delight over implementation convenience, ship fewer polished features over more rough ones, justify every feature and option, prototype in throwaway code before committing, and sweat the details (transitions, alignment, spacing, feedback, error states) while keeping the core loop tight. The "user" is whoever consumes the work — end user, the colleague importing your library, or the engineer maintaining the code next.
